input: I enter the correct password but after clicking Sign In the page just keeps loading. It happens in prod after the last deploy.

expected.issue: Login stays stuck loading after valid credentials are submitted.

input: User can log in, but when they hit the admin role screen they see a 403 even though they have the perm. This is in staging.

expected.issue: Users with valid admin access still receive permission errors on the roles screen.

input: POST /v1/invoices returns 500 when a valid payload is sent. This started after the API rollout and affects production.

expected.issue: Invoice API requests fail with a server error for valid payloads.

input: The checkout button is greyed out after I add an item, even tho the cart is valid. Works in Chrome but not Safari, weird.

expected.issue: Checkout button remains disabled after a valid cart update.

input: Order table gets stuck and the app stops responding when we run the daily report. Prod DB is lagging hard.

expected.issue: Database load causes the application to stop responding during reporting jobs.

input: Dashboard is a bit slow sometimes. Not sure if it's just me but it feels bad after 3pm. Please fix if possible.

expected.issue: Dashboard performance degrades intermittently during normal usage.

input: A user can reset a password with a token that already expired, then they get access to the account. This is a serious security issue.

expected.issue: Expired reset tokens can still grant access to user accounts.

input: When I try to submit my address, the app says it's invalid even though the ZIP is correct. It only happens on the shipping form.

expected.issue: Shipping form rejects a valid address format.

input: The app is broken after the upgrade. Everybody says it is messed up somehow.

expected.issue: General app instability follows the recent upgrade.

input: On Android, I tap sign in with my saved account and it says wrong password even though I am using the right one. Happens only on the mobile app.

expected.issue: Mobile app rejects valid saved credentials during sign-in.

input: The manager role stopped working for some users after the permission sync. Not sure if this is a config issue or a bug.

expected.issue: Some user accounts no longer receive the expected manager permissions after sync.

input: GET /reports/weekly returns a 502 when the date range is two months. It is reproducible with the same payload every time.

expected.issue: Weekly reports endpoint fails with a 502 for longer date ranges.

input: The settings page is kinda busted on my tablet. I can open it, but it doesn't look right and some buttons are missing.

expected.issue: Settings page layout is broken and some controls are missing on tablet devices.

input: Select a customer and click History. The report hangs for 30 seconds, then fails in staging. This is repeatable with our test tenant.

expected.issue: Customer history query hangs before returning results.

input: Search feels slow on the main page, especially during busy periods. Hard to tell if it is a server issue or just the browser.

expected.issue: Search requests are noticeably slow during busy traffic periods.

input: User email reset token can be reused after it is marked invalid. Verified against a test account in prod.

expected.issue: Invalidated reset tokens can still be used to access an account.

input: I enter a valid zip code and click save, but the billing form says it is invalid. It happens every time in web.

expected.issue: Billing form rejects a valid ZIP code value.

input: Something weird happened after deploy and some users started seeing odd behavior in the app. We cannot tell what triggered it.

expected.issue: Unclear post-deploy regression causing inconsistent user-visible behavior.

input: I can log in with a valid SSO account but my session disappears immediately after redirect. This affects users across the org and blocks access.

expected.issue: Users lose their session immediately after SSO login redirects back to the application.

input: A few users cannot edit invoices after the role sync. Maybe the permissions script is wrong but nobody knows for sure.

expected.issue: Some users cannot edit invoices after the role permission sync.

input: The app sometimes returns partial JSON for the user profile endpoint. It is not consistent and feature teams are complaining.

expected.issue: User profile endpoint intermittently returns incomplete JSON payloads.

input: On iOS, the checkout step crashes right after tapping Place Order. It happens every time with a valid cart and we have a repro video.

expected.issue: Checkout crashes on iOS when the user submits a valid order.

input: The reports query is timing out in prod and some jobs fail, but no one can say exactly when. Based on the logs it seems database related.

expected.issue: Database-backed reports intermittently time out in production.

input: The analytics page is nearly unusable during peak load. CPU spikes and the page takes 20s to draw. Repro is easy with a large dataset.

expected.issue: Analytics page becomes unusable under peak load due to severe rendering delays.

input: Some admin users can still access account data after a session timeout. This seems serious but not all cases are clear.

expected.issue: Some users may retain access to account data after session expiration.

input: The password reset form rejects a valid new password because it says the minimum length is 12 but we entered 12 and it still failed. Repro steps attached.

expected.issue: Password reset validation rejects a valid password at the minimum length threshold.

input: After deploy the new dashboard looks wrong for one customer and the top nav overlaps. We have one screenshot but no clear steps.

expected.issue: Dashboard layout is misrendered for one customer after the deploy.

input: signin on windows keeps failing for my account and it says invalid creds even when I copied the password correctly. Might be cache issue.

expected.issue: Windows user sign-in incorrectly reports invalid credentials despite a correct password.

input: The file upload dropzone freezes after I select a file, and the submit button never re-enables. Happens every time in Chrome on Linux.

expected.issue: Upload dropzone freezes and never re-enables after a file is selected.

input: A customer report is missing from the daily export. We can reproduce it by running the export job twice in staging with the same date range.

expected.issue: Daily export omits a customer report when the export job is run repeatedly.
